title: Finding something in the developer tool

posts.author: BottleBlonde
posts.body: Hi, I'm currently in the developer tools window for rpg maker mv and I was wondering where the code for my game itself is. What I mean by this is I've found the code for the base/building blocks of rpg maker itself (rpg_core.js), but not for my game such as text/speech from npcs, battles, characters, etc. If anyone can guide me towards that, I'd be very grateful! Thank you very much! >_<

posts.author: Robro33
posts.body:
BottleBlonde said:
but not for my game such as text/speech from npcs, battles, characters, etc.
Click to expand...
those can be found in the .json files inside of the data folder. actors have their own file, battles are in the troops file, and events are a part of the individual map files

posts.body: Isn't all of that in the data folder.... It's stored in the Data files [Maps, Items, actors, etc]?

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body:
BottleBlonde said:
Found them! Tysm! Kind of a silly follow-up, but does anyone know how to convert them to comprehensive JavaScript? No worries if not
Click to expand...
Json IS comprehensive javascript. They're javascript objects. They get parsed by whatever function in the core file is calling them.
Edit: Apparently it's a string and you have to convert it to an object with JSON.parse(text)
